the μ is the most important parameter for the overproduction and accumulation of recombinant protein in E. coli, and that the feeding strategy based on the μ control is a promising approach for the production of recombinant products.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the μ‐control feeding strategy was the most effective method for the production of recombinant protein in high‐cell density cultures of E. col.
the feeding strategies should be based on μ and the feeding should be started as soon as possible after the induction of protein synthesis to achieve the maximum productivity of recombinant protein.

The main takeaway from our work is that
μ is an important factor in the design of feeding strategies for recombinant‐proteins production, especially when the recombinant protein is expressed from an inducible promoter.
the specific growth rate is an important parameter that should be controlled during the process of recombinant protein production in high‐cell density cultures.
the specific growth rate of the cells should not be reduced below a certain threshold value, in order to maintain a high recombinant protein productivity.
